crossRefs.note: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of…
When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Arumah
people.line: A city associated with Abimelech and King Jehoiakim's mother.

people.name: Gaal
people.line: Son of Ebed; led a revolt against Abimelech.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: Abimelech lived at Arumah; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
translations.bsb: Abimelech stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.
translations.kjv: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
translations.asv: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
